'''2011 Worlds Day 3 Steve Baroni DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Steve Baroni]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 3).

Sheet name '''Baroni'''; deck '''Lott Dod we like to party'''.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[My Lord, Is That Legal?]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
